run_eval_overthink_benchmark: run the evaluation script on a JSONL file to assess model overthinking and underthinking accuracy
run_eval_math_subset: run the evaluation script to evaluate math problem accuracy for a given model
run_eval_token_count: run the evaluation script to count tokens used by a model across benchmark subsets
run_eval_format_metrics: run the evaluation script to compute macro accuracy, score, and F1 across overthink and underthink splits
run_eval_model_to_tokenizer: run the evaluation script with a model name to automatically resolve the correct tokenizer
